description:
Manually catalog a research dataset and link it to its associated paper.

Your task:
1. Create a new item of type 'Dataset' in your library.
2. Enter the following metadata exactly:
   - Title: 'ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database'
   - Author: 'Deng, Jia' (Last, First)
   - Date: '2009'
   - URL: 'http://www.image-net.org'
   - Repository: 'Princeton Vision Lab'
3. Link this new dataset item to the existing paper 'ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks' using the 'Related' tab.

Steps:
- Click the 'New Item' button (green plus) and select 'Dataset' (you may need to look under 'More').
- Fill in the metadata fields in the right-hand panel.
- Go to the 'Related' tab in the right-hand panel.
- Click 'Add' and select the Krizhevsky et al. paper from the list.
- Click OK.

metadata.target_paper_title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
metadata.dataset_title: ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database
